title: BLMR UP-IND-BI Security Under IND-CPA
summary: The existing proof sketch is flawed, and the source considers the implied circular-security reduction unlikely; whether security follows from IND-CPA or can be ruled out remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For the BLMR scheme, determine whether $\text{UP-IND-BI}$ security can be established under only $\text{IND-CPA}$ security of the underlying KEM, despite the bug in the existing proof sketch, or instead prove that such a security proof cannot exist by separating $\text{IND-CPA}$ security from the circular security it would imply for a simple KEM/DEM-style symmetric-encryption scheme; the latter implication is considered unlikely in light of known negative results.

scope.domain: Security proofs for authenticated-encryption key-rotation schemes.
assumptions: IND-CPA security of the underlying KEM
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the proof can be established under only IND-CPA security of the underlying KEM, or whether such a proof can be ruled out by separating IND-CPA security from the circular security it would imply for a simple KEM/DEM-style symmetric-encryption scheme.

progress.summary: The source notes that the existing UP-IND-BI proof sketch has a bug but does not give a direct attack or settle whether it can be repaired. It instead presents an implication to circular security and considers that implication unlikely in light of known negative results.
citation_labels: Adam Everspaugh et al., Key Rotation for Authenticated Encryption
